lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Captain,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: listen to this.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: It's about my parrot.
Morgan?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Once you get to know him,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: he's incredibly smart and insightful,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: but a lot of people never get to see that side of him.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: They think he's a bit dense,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: and make fun of him for it.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Isn't that mean?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: What do you think I should do

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: so that more people can see Morgan's true colors?
Get him to do a trick in front of people.
To be honest, I didn't realize Morgan was terribly intelligent either.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: That might be tough.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: One time I tried to teach him Bang Bang.
Never heard of that one.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: You know, when you pretend to shoot someone

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: and they play dead.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Anyway, I tried it on him, but then he went ahead and said,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Bang, Bang! and glared at me.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: In the end, I was the one who played dead for him.
He's quite something.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: That's what I'm saying!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Something else crazy happened the other day too.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I mean, I'll concede that

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: he doesn't look like the sharpest tool in the shed.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: But what if it's all a ruse?
How smart is he?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I can't explain it!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Something weird did happen the other day, though.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Helm was having trouble cleaning the cabin,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: and kept nagging at me for the longest time.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Suddenly, Morgan, who was to the side taking this all in,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: leaps up and shouts,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Starfish! Starfish!
... Interesting.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: As you can imagine,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Helm was gobsmacked.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: She stopped pestering me, turned pale as a sheet, and ran off.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: As you know,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: she's petrified of squishy sea creatures,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: but I don't think Morgan can count on this trick working too many times.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Otherwise, it'll be a case of the parrot who cried wolf, and Helm eventually won't be scared anymore.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: However, since Morgan is so darn smart,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: he considered this already, and came up with ways to mix it up.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: So this morning,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: when Helm was about to blow her top

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: and unload on Anchor and me regarding the schedule,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Morgan piped up and bellowed out a new one,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Sea anemone! Sea anemone!
Ha!

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: And just like that, no more Helm riding our backs! Hehe.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Just now,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I saw him practicing for the next one.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I overheard him squawking, "Sea squirt! Sea squirt!"

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I've never seen it in my life
I think it may be because

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: such a hyper-intelligent parrot
Anchor secretly taught him these

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: that cares for his owner.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Whoa, would you look at the time?

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I better get going.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Helm wanted me to take care of something,

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: so I better get on that.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: I can't always rely on Morgan to cover for me.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: The number one solution for avoiding Helm's wrath would be to finish my work on time.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Well, I'm off then.

lines.speaker: mast
lines.text: Hope you have an exciting day!
You too.
